scenarios.scenario: Toggle visibility from the solid bodies folder

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains one visible solid block
the Solid Bodies folder is visible in the model browser
the user right-clicks the Solid Bodies folder
its context menu offers Visibility, Expand All Children and collapses All Children
Visibility is checked
the user chooses Visibility
the shaded block is hidden and its body remains listed in the browser
the user right-clicks the Solid Bodies folder again
Visibility is unchecked
the user chooses Visibility again
the shaded block returns in the same apparent view

scenarios.scenario: Collapse descendants of the Origin folder

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software

the user right-clicks the Origin folder
its context menu offers Expand All Children and collapses All Children
the user chooses Collapse All Children
the Origin folder remains expanded with its direct reference rows visible
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user clicks the Origin expansion control
the reference rows are hidden and the Origin folder remains visible
the user clicks the Origin expansion control again
the reference rows are visible again

scenarios.scenario: Cancel a sketch line color change

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a dimensioned sketch is nested under an extrusion in the MCAD Software
its line color is Default
the user opens Properties from the sketch row context menu
the user opens the Line Color list
the list offers Default, Black, Red, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue, Magenta and White
it offers a Select action
the user chooses Red
the Line Color field displays Red and Apply is enabled
the user clicks Cancel and reopens the sketch properties
the Line Color field displays Default and Apply is disabled
the user clicks Cancel
the properties dialog closes

scenarios.scenario: Inspect and cancels the custom line color picker

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software

the dialog expands to show a color field, brightness control and color preview

it offers Add to Custom Colors
the user cancels the color dialog
the geometry properties dialog shows Default line color
Apply is disabled
the user cancels the geometry properties dialog
the dialog closes without applying a color change
